---
name: "nf-core/bam_qc_rnaseq"
description: "Run post-alignment QC tools on RNA-seq BAM files including library complexity\n\
  estimation (Preseq), biotype QC (featureCounts), RNA-seq-specific QC metrics\n(Qualimap),\
  \ duplicate rate analysis (dupRadar), and comprehensive RSeQC analysis.\n"
keywords:
- "rnaseq"
- "bam"
- "qc"
- "quality_control"
- "preseq"
- "qualimap"
- "dupradar"
- "rseqc"
- "featurecounts"
- "biotype"
components:
- "preseq/lcextrap"
- "qualimap/rnaseq"
- "dupradar"
- "subread/featurecounts"
- "custom/multiqccustombiotype"
- "samtools/sort"
- "bam_rseqc"
input:
- ch_bam_bai:
    type: "file"
    description: "Coordinate-sorted BAM file aligned to the genome, with its index.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), path(bam), path(bai) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{bam,bai}"
- ch_gtf:
    type: "file"
    description: "GTF annotation file.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(gtf) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{gtf}"
- ch_gene_bed:
    type: "file"
    description: "BED12 file for the reference gene model.\n\nStructure: [ path(bed)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{bed}"
- ch_fasta_fai:
    type: "file"
    description: "FASTA reference and its index, used by samtools sort.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(fasta), path(fai) ]\n"
- ch_biotypes_header:
    type: "file"
    description: "Header file for the biotype counts MultiQC section.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(biotypes_header.txt) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{txt}"
- tools:
    type: "list"
    description: "List of QC tools to run. Top-level tools: 'preseq', 'biotype_qc',\
      \ 'qualimap',\n'dupradar'. RSeQC modules use an 'rseqc_' prefix: 'rseqc_bam_stat',\n\
      'rseqc_inner_distance', 'rseqc_infer_experiment', 'rseqc_junction_annotation',\n\
      'rseqc_junction_saturation', 'rseqc_read_distribution', 'rseqc_read_duplication',\n\
      'rseqc_tin'. Pass an empty list to skip all.\n"
- biotype:
    type: "string"
    description: "GTF attribute for biotype grouping (e.g. \"gene_type\" or \"gene_biotype\"\
      ).\nOnly used when 'biotype_qc' is in tools. Set to empty string to skip biotype\
      \ QC.\n"
output:
- multiqc_files:
    type: "file"
    description: "Collected MultiQC-compatible output files from all enabled tools.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), path(files) ]\n"
- preseq_lc_extrap:
    type: "file"
    description: "Preseq library complexity extrapolation curve.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(txt) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.lc_extrap.txt"
- preseq_log:
    type: "file"
    description: "Preseq log file.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(log) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.log"
- featurecounts_counts:
    type: "file"
    description: "featureCounts count matrix.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(txt)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.featureCounts.txt"
- featurecounts_summary:
    type: "file"
    description: "featureCounts summary statistics.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(txt)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.featureCounts.txt.summary"
- biotype_tsv:
    type: "file"
    description: "Biotype counts formatted for MultiQC bargraph.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(tsv) ]\n"
    pattern: "*biotype_counts_mqc.tsv"
- biotype_rrna:
    type: "file"
    description: "rRNA percentage for MultiQC general stats.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(tsv) ]\n"
    pattern: "*biotype_counts_rrna_mqc.tsv"
- qualimap_results:
    type: "directory"
    description: "Qualimap RNA-seq QC results directory.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(dir) ]\n"
- dupradar_scatter2d:
    type: "file"
    description: "PDF duplication rate against total read count plot.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(pdf) ]\n"
    pattern: "*_duprateExpDens.pdf"
- dupradar_boxplot:
    type: "file"
    description: "PDF duplication rate ~ total reads per kilobase (RPK) boxplot.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), path(pdf) ]\n"
    pattern: "*_duprateExpBoxplot.pdf"
- dupradar_hist:
    type: "file"
    description: "PDF expression histogram.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(pdf) ]\n"
    pattern: "*_expressionHist.pdf"
- dupradar_dupmatrix:
    type: "file"
    description: "Text file containing tags falling on the features described in the\
      \ GTF file.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(txt) ]\n"
    pattern: "*_dupMatrix.txt"
- dupradar_intercept_slope:
    type: "file"
    description: "Text file containing intercept and slope from dupRadar modelling.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), path(txt) ]\n"
    pattern: "*_intercept_slope.txt"
- dupradar_multiqc:
    type: "file"
    description: "dupRadar MultiQC-compatible output.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(txt)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*_mqc.txt"
- inferexperiment_txt:
    type: "file"
    description: "RSeQC infer_experiment results (for strandedness detection).\n\n\
      Structure: [ val(meta), path(txt) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.infer_experiment.txt"
- bamstat_txt:
    type: "file"
    description: "RSeQC bam_stat report.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(txt) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.bam_stat.txt"
- innerdistance_all:
    type: "file"
    description: "All the output files from RSeQC inner_distance.\n\nStructure: [\
      \ val(meta), path(txt/pdf/r) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{txt,pdf,R}"
- innerdistance_distance:
    type: "file"
    description: "The inner distances.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(txt) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.inner_distance.txt"
- innerdistance_freq:
    type: "file"
    description: "Frequencies of different insert sizes.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(txt) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.inner_distance_freq.txt"
- innerdistance_mean:
    type: "file"
    description: "Mean/median values of inner distances.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(txt) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.inner_distance_mean.txt"
- innerdistance_pdf:
    type: "file"
    description: "Distribution plot of inner distances.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(pdf) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.inner_distance_plot.pdf"
- innerdistance_rscript:
    type: "file"
    description: "Script to reproduce the inner distance plot.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(r) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.inner_distance_plot.R"
- junctionannotation_all:
    type: "file"
    description: "All the output files from RSeQC junction_annotation.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(bed/xls/pdf/r/log) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{bed,xls,pdf,R,log}"
- junctionannotation_bed:
    type: "file"
    description: "BED file of annotated junctions.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(bed)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.junction.bed"
- junctionannotation_interact_bed:
    type: "file"
    description: "Interact BED file.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(bed) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.Interact.bed"
- junctionannotation_xls:
    type: "file"
    description: "XLS file with junction information.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(xls)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.xls"
- junctionannotation_pdf:
    type: "file"
    description: "Junction plot.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(pdf) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.junction.pdf"
- junctionannotation_events_pdf:
    type: "file"
    description: "Events plot.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(pdf) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.events.pdf"
- junctionannotation_rscript:
    type: "file"
    description: "Rscript to reproduce the junction annotation plots.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(r) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.r"
- junctionannotation_log:
    type: "file"
    description: "Log file generated by RSeQC junction_annotation.\n\nStructure: [\
      \ val(meta), path(log) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.log"
- junctionsaturation_all:
    type: "file"
    description: "All the output files from RSeQC junction_saturation.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(pdf/r) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{pdf,R}"
- junctionsaturation_pdf:
    type: "file"
    description: "Junction saturation report.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(pdf)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.pdf"
- junctionsaturation_rscript:
    type: "file"
    description: "Junction saturation R-script.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(r)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.r"
- readdistribution_txt:
    type: "file"
    description: "RSeQC read_distribution report.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(txt)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.read_distribution.txt"
- readduplication_all:
    type: "file"
    description: "All the output files from RSeQC read_duplication.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(xls/pdf/r) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{xls,pdf,R}"
- readduplication_seq_xls:
    type: "file"
    description: "Read duplication rate determined from the sequence of the read.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), path(xls) ]\n"
    pattern: "*seq.DupRate.xls"
- readduplication_pos_xls:
    type: "file"
    description: "Read duplication rate determined from the mapping position of the\
      \ read.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(xls) ]\n"
    pattern: "*pos.DupRate.xls"
- readduplication_pdf:
    type: "file"
    description: "Plot of duplication rate.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(pdf) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.pdf"
- readduplication_rscript:
    type: "file"
    description: "Script to reproduce the duplication rate plot.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(r) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.R"
- tin_txt:
    type: "file"
    description: "RSeQC TIN results summary.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(txt)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.txt"
- per_sample_mqc_bundle:
    type: "file"
    description: "Per-sample MultiQC-feeding outputs (Preseq, biotype TSV, Qualimap,\n\
      dupRadar, and RSeQC bamstat/inferexperiment/innerdistance_freq/\njunctionannotation_log/junctionsaturation_rscript/readdistribution/\n\
      readduplication_pos/tin) joined on meta.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), list(files)\
      \ ]\n"
authors:
- "@pinin4fjords"
maintainers:
- "@pinin4fjords"
version: "0.0.0-df69bf6"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/dupradar@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/preseq/lcextrap@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/qualimap/rnaseq@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/subread/featurecounts@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/custom/multiqccustombiotype@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/samtools/sort@0.0.0-df69bf6"
  - "nf-core/bam_rseqc@0.0.0-6d1763b"
